_schema.bbox_wgs84: [west, south, east, north] — WARP THE GRID TO EPSG:4326 FIRST and use the warped bounds. Do NOT just reproject the RD bbox corners: RD New is rotated against WGS84, so the square's four corners do not share two longitudes and a rectangle built from two of them misplaces the overlay by ~30 m. See reproject_to_wgs84() in analysis/morphology/sky_view_factor.py.
_schema.values: row-major 2D array, row 0 = north, |U| / undisturbed inflow at the same height, null = building or no data
